data.title: 角楯花凛 · 奢华套房床榻的依偎温存
data.description: 夜色深沉的高级海景套房里，花凛侧卧在凌乱的丝绸床单上，纯白丝绸睡袍轻拢勾勒出深肤色矫健而性感的极致曲线。她依恋地靠向老师怀中，修长美腿自然交迭，金瞳满溢着毫无保留的信赖与情潮。
data.action: reclining on silk bed, head resting on pillow, hugging close, flushed sensuality
data.lighting: deep romantic moonlight from floor-to-ceiling windows and warm floor lamps
data.promptProse: Reclining comfortably on a grand penthouse silk bed at midnight in a loosely tied white silk robe, Kakudate Karin gazes up with melting golden eyes and radiant tanned skin.
data.animaCaption: Karin reclining comfortably on a silk bed in a loosely tied white robe.
